title: Jacky Chou on dropshipping mistakes, Amazon affiliate moves and buying penalized sites
summary: Jacky Chou walks through his dropshipping exit and its biggest mistake, how he sources cheaper from 1688, and why Amazon affiliates should sell their own FBA products. He also covers buying algo-hit sites and expired domains, and hiring operators by buying their sites or giving equity.

principles.text: Once a dropshipping product wins, immediately source it, ship it to a local warehouse and cut delivery to about a week.
principles.quote: if you find a winner you immediately source it ship it to the us or wherever your winners are and then keep in a warehouse so people actually like get their products within a week you know

principles.text: Source from China's domestic wholesale site 1688 (or hire a Chinese speaker) to cut product costs 20-30%.
principles.quote: there's a chinese version of alibaba called 1688 uh it's literally alibaba's chinese version and it's only for chinese people and the prices are like 20 to 30 percent cheaper

principles.text: Amazon affiliates controlling traffic should launch their own private-label FBA products, since Amazon converts far better than a Shopify store.
principles.quote: 1.5 conversion rate on shopify versus like 30 conversion rate on amazon same exact same product

principles.text: Buy sites hit by Google algo penalties: demoralized sellers sell cheap for cash, and fixing speed, design and links often revives revenue.
principles.quote: i absolutely love sites hit with algo penalties it's um okay your viewers might not like this but it's a bit predatory but it plays on the psychology of the seller

principles.text: Judge expired or auction domains by the number of Ahrefs ranking keywords, not DR or backlink cleanliness.
principles.quote: it's always number of ahrefs keywords i don't care about any other metric

principles.text: Find top operators by buying their site and hiring them, and use equity upside to recruit when commission-only fails.
principles.quote: you just buy buy their site and then offer them a job because you like what they're doing right you know like they have a system in place they know how to rank
